highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 bumps to the Skia m153 engine, including upstream bug fixes.

breaking.title: Linux font fallback may select a different face
breaking.body: Skia now tries FcFontMatch before falling back to FcFontSort on Linux. Apps relying on the exact fallback face may see different glyphs or metrics after upgrading; specify an explicit family/style or bundle a typeface when deterministic selection matters.

bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to milestone 153 and merges upstream chrome/m153 bug fixes.
Updates the .NET SDK and container pins used to build and test SkiaSharp to 10.0.400.
